text:
Maya Patel: FYI deploys to gpu-pool-3 started failing around 10:12 with 403s on serviceAccount deploy-runner. KMS decrypt errors in the same window. Possibly related to last night's RBAC changes.

Jordan Lee: I'm seeing the 403s in the deploy-runner pod logs — kube api returns: "Forbidden: user \"system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-runner\" cannot list resource \"deployments\" in API group \"apps\" in the namespace \"gpu-pool-3\"". KMS errors: "permission denied for decrypt".

Sam O'Connor: quick check — did the automated role refactor change any namespace-scoped bindings? I remember we rolled out a gatekeeper constraint to tighten SA permissions last night.

access-policy-bot: Applied constraint 'restrict-serviceaccounts' to namespace gpu-pool-3 at 2025-11-29T02:15:12Z (enforced=true).

Priya Nair: that bot applied a deny-list of clusterrolebindings for SAs in prod-ish namespaces. Looks like gpu-pool-3 got picked up by the rule because of label mismatch.

Jordan Lee: repro steps I ran:
```
kubectl -n gpu-pool-3 get rolebinding -o wide | grep deploy-runner
kubectl -n gpu-pool-3 describe rolebinding deploy-runner
kubectl -n gpu-pool-3 auth can-i list deployments --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-runner
```
Result: no edit privileges, only view. The refactor removed the namespaced rolebinding and replaced it with a more restrictive clusterRole reference.

Maya Patel: immediate mitigation: create a temporary namespaced rolebinding granting edit to deploy-runner and add KMS decrypt permission via provider IAM. I'm going to run the commands now, will post output.

Jordan Lee: sgtm — add a short TTL note in the rolebinding annotations so we can find and revert it later. Eg: "rbac-temp-rollback: true, expires: 2025-11-29T15:00:00Z"

Maya Patel: ran:
```
kubectl create rolebinding deploy-runner-edit -n gpu-pool-3 --role=edit --serviceaccount=ci:deploy-runner --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
# add annotation
kubectl annotate rolebinding deploy-runner-edit -n gpu-pool-3 rbac-temp-rollback=true rbac-temp-expires=2025-11-29T15:00:00Z --overwrite
# KMS (GCP example)
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redsandbox/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/decrypt-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:deploy-runner@ci.svc.id.goog --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter || true
```
Deployed temporary binding, deploys started succeeding again ~10:24. Rolling back not yet.

Sam O'Connor: good. We need to capture the audit trail: filter audit logs for gatekeeper and rolebinding changes in the 02:00-02:20 window. Also collect controller-manager and policy webhook traces.

Priya Nair: notes on root cause hypothesis: gatekeeper constraint used namespace label selector that was too broad; also our deploy-runner SA isn't listed in the allowlist used by the constraint. Two simultaneous gaps: RBAC refactor removed a safe namespaced binding, and the constraint blocked the fallback cluster binding.

Jordan Lee: suggested long-term fixes:
- narrow gatekeeper constraint selectors to explicit namespaces or add explicit exclude list
- add CI deploy SA to an allowlist for KMS decrypt in the KMS IAM policy (or switch to short-lived Workload Identity tokens)
- add a post-deploy check in the refactor rollout job that validates critical SAs still have required permissions (auth can-i smoke tests)

Maya Patel: will open a follow-up RFC for least-privilege rollouts with a mandatory rollback test and audit-proof checklist. Also creating a postmortem and assigning eng-security + eng-sre.

access-policy-bot: Created ticket https://jira.redwoodinference.com/browse/SSEC-4127 for gatekeeper selector tuning.

ops-oncall: adding an alert to paging on 5xx/403 deploy failure rate for kube-controller-manager and KMS decrypt errors. Threshold: >5 failing deploys in 10m.

Sam O'Connor: quick forensic commands for the postmortem:
```
# audit log filter (GCP example)
resource.type=\"k8s_cluster\" AND protoPayload.methodName:\"SetIamPolicy\" OR protoPayload.serviceName:\"container.googleapis.com\" AND timestamp>=\"2025-11-29T02:00:00Z\" AND timestamp<=\"2025-11-29T02:30:00Z\"
# gatekeeper constraints
kubectl get constraints -A | grep restrict-serviceaccounts
kubectl -n gpu-pool-3 get pods -o wide | grep gatekeeper
```

Priya Nair: follow-ups:
- Maya to own postmortem + timeline (ETA EOD)
- Jordan to add CI smoke test for deploy SA permissions (PR by EOD tomorrow)
- Sam to propose gatekeeper selector change and rollback plan (PR + test harness)
- Security to review KMS bindings for least-privilege (recommend Workload Identity if not already used)

Maya Patel: ok creating the postmortem now and adding links to the temp rolebinding and KMS binding. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
